```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split the two equal-height panels at the solid separator row.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]
    n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
    return [
        [2 if top[r][c] == 0 and bottom[r][c] == 0 else 0
         for c in range(w)]
        for r in range(n)
    ]
```
